selection.why: Pane-3-owned cross-score matrix directly controls whether COD-H1 through COD-H5 can reach rung 3; no non-author audit receipt was present.

supersession and rung2 artifacts had lower arithmetic leverage

arithmetic.command: Python inline checker asserts each table delta equals non-author score minus author score and source-file references are present.

findings.detail: All five deltas recompute exactly: -30, -20, -20, -35, -55. Author/non-author direction and score ordering are internally consistent.
Codex #36718 is a real evidence-backed-completion issue and supports the stated demand pain. The target correctly narrows the gap rather than pretending deterministic substitutes do not exist.

The target calls both tools real/maintained and 0–1 stars. Their existence and adjacent scope were independently found, but this audit did not re-pin current star counts or release freshness. This is a source-freshness limit, not an arithmetic error.
The target explicitly says Spec Kit #4290, AgentAbstain, and AbstainQA were cited-not-verified and discounts H2 by 30. This is honest handling, not an unsupported positive claim.
The target distinguishes four tool-boundary issues plus one protocol issue, names the replay-corpus gap, and does not convert issue count into adoption proof.
OpenClaw #3560 flush-after-truncation failure is consistent with the cited source search; the target records the duplicate closure caveat and discounts cross-framework buyer scope.

The 262% arithmetic and LiteLLM #38064 mechanism rederive from the public issue summary, but exact code-line reproduction and current fix status were not locally run here. The target appropriately calls the audience narrow and keeps H3 below its own 900 bar.

The target criticism is structurally valid: COD rank accepts vendor adoption material for Demo-9 while treating Codex #36718 as insufficient external voice for Demo-4, despite the latter describing evidence-backed completion pain. This is reasoning analysis, not a numeric contradiction.
The target explicitly bounds unverified sources, installations, adoption, and implementation claims.

retry_condition: Re-audit H1/H3 source freshness before promotion or after external source/version changes; no score rewrite is authorized from this audit alone.
